## PatchViewer v2.0.0

### Added

- Added hold-to-view quick diff support for patched blocks and units in-game.
- Added two quick display modes: a near-cursor HUD and an injected build-info panel.
- Added settings for quick display mode, HUD opacity, HUD width, and HUD background color.
- Added compact icon/stack rendering for quick diffs, including build costs, inputs, outputs, mineable ores, weapons, and other icon-heavy stats.
- Added normalized unit icon sizing in patched database stats.
- Added clickable unit icons in patched database stats to open the unit's core database page.

### Changed

- Improved quick diff formatting so repeated stack/icon entries are deduplicated per individual item.
- Improved compact stack display with icon-first layout and shortened large values.
- Kept the core database stat body close to the original game layout while preserving PatchViewer diff highlighting.

### Fixed

- Fixed quick HUD/build-info rendering regressions for mineable ores and other icon-only stat rows.
- Fixed several stack/icon color and wrapping issues in compact quick diffs.
- Fixed crash-prone recursive cleanup behavior in patched stat rendering.
